chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Regarding
the man who plays with the boy, he said: 'When he reaches puberty, his sister and his daughter become forbidden (to him).'
ai.seo_question: What is the marital prohibition if a man has sexual relations with a boy?
ai.summary: In the context of Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the ruling of *al-Furūq* (differentiation) where sexual play (*al-Lamās* or *al-Istiqā’*) with a boy creates a permanent marital prohibition, analogous to that of a son. It highlights the juristic debate on whether such acts constitute a minor or major impediment to marriage, establishing the boy's sister and daughter as permanently forbidden (*Mahram*) to the man.
